Fruit Cookie Pie
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:22pm

Ingredients




1 pkt Cookie dough
8 ounces Cream cheese
1/2 cup Confectioner's sugar(powdered)
2 cups Fresh fruit
2 cups Fresh fruit, mashed
 cup Cornstarch
1 cup Sugar
Whipped topping

Preparation

1 Press dough into bottom of large spring form pan. 2 Bake until golden brown. 3 Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar. Spread on baked cookie dough. 4 Arrange 2 cups of fruit on top. 5 Cook mashed fruit with sugar and cornstarch until thickened. 6 Cool and pour over fruit. 7 Garnish with whipped cream.
